name: thermosyphon_hx
title: Thermosyphon (heat-pipe) tube-bank heat exchanger with ESDU operating limits
summary: Crossflow heat-pipe heat exchanger: flue gas over the evaporator bank, water boiling/condensing inside each thermosyphon (ESDU pool/film resistances, vapour pressure drop, axial wall conduction), Cyclopentane over the condenser bank (forced convection + Rohsenow nucleate boiling, CHF-capped), ESDU operating limits per row, 61 tube rows marched in counter-flow. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexThermosyphon, external side adapted (2026-11-01).

verification.summary: Adapted model: stream energy balances closed to 1.4e-6 W on 6.06 MW, cold inlet met exactly, full model equal to an independent row-by-row marching to 1.7e-6, flux <= 11 % of CHF. Correlation translation checked against an instrumented LaboThapPy re-run before the adaptation (single-phase rows within 0.6 %).
verification.reference: hex_thermosyphon_example.py re-run (LaboThapPy f03f7f47, CoolProp 8.0.0), instrumented to record the row states; independent row-by-row marching with the 3-row model
verification.notes: Source issues corrected: CHF (Lienhard-Eichhorn q_max) used as an HTC -> forced convection + Rohsenow (source's own pool_boiling constants) capped at the pool CHF; one cold velocity from the outlet vapour density (oil code) -> continuity per row and phase; nozzle() without the critical-flow factor -> continuity; per-tube balances with the whole bank flow -> row states from the marching; ESDU limits returned as fluxes labelled W -> per-tube limits with areas, explicit FUNCTION. First review: CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW root cause (branch fix/ad-pow-negative-base; products used here), 11 unit/state errors of the translation. Results: 6.061 MW (source 5.869); row 1 at the entrainment limit (641.6 K heat pipe, 5.5 K below water Tc); dry-out correlation of the source exceeded in all rows. Full solve ~10 min (dense AD, 3599-variable block).

history.action: review of the failing models: root cause of the iteration-0 SingularJacobian found (CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW, fixed on CoolSolve branch fix/ad-pow-negative-base); translation unit errors corrected in both files; row-companion inputs/initials from an instrumented source re-run; single-phase rows verified within 0.6 %; stays failing (two-phase rows)

second review: external side adapted (boiling superposition with CHF cap, continuity velocities, nozzle, row states from the marching, operating-limit units); full model converges (initials from a row-by-row marching); failing -> verified (adapted); .initials/.sol for both files; nozzle tables removed
